calls.reason: The packet has no independent test of DALL-E Mini on ellipsis, comparatives or pronouns. The model card only notes general rendering problems, and the child-language study covers one ellipsis task.

OpenAI's DALL-E 2 report admits weak attribute binding, as in the red/blue cube example. Liu et al. (June 2022) found DALL-E 2 and GLIDE fail on object relations, so pre-post evidence clearly shows compositional problems.

Li, Nye and Andreas (2021), published before the post, decoded and edited structured entity-state representations in BART and T5. That gave reason to doubt 'at all', though the representations were limited and error-prone.
This is a broad causal claim framed as 'in our view'. The LaMDA fine-tuning results and the Li et al. probing study do not isolate the three factors or test all three listed consequences.
The packet has no independent records or replication of the authors' DALL-E Mini trials for this prompt. The only source is the post itself.
Scaling-law and GPT-3 results show that data and model size matter, and Li et al. shows state representations matter in other models. No study compares their relative contributions in GPT-3.
